name: Ungoogled-chromium
tagline: Google Chromium, sans dependency on Google web services.
description: Ungoogled Chromium is Google Chromium, sans dependency on Google web services.

questions.label: Web port
questions.hint: The port on this server that opens the app.

compose:
services:
  app:
    image: linuxserver/ungoogled-chromium:155.0.8059@sha256:6eb82d737db6f4d80c00aa0841f8d142280a36625e6e0c3f9dd198ef5fd7d2ed
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      PUID: $PUID
      PGID: $PGID
      TZ: $TZ
      CHROME_CLI: ''
    ports:
      - target: 3000
        published: "${APP_PORT}"
        protocol: tcp
      - target: 3001
        published: 3001
        protocol: tcp
    volumes:
      - type: bind
        source: ${APP_DATA_DIR}/config
        target: /config
